cohort: Females with idiopathic scoliosis who delivered in an integrated healthcare system
finding: Females with scoliosis were significantly more likely to receive epidural anesthesia during delivery compared with females without scoliosis, but rates of cesarean delivery were not significantly different.
mod_finding: The study found that females with scoliosis who did not undergo spine fusion had a significantly lower rate of Cesarean delivery compared to those without scoliosis.
